reference_boundary: Official OpenAI prompt cache source docs are citation metadata and governance references only. This manifest defines API-backed runner pilot and token/cost governance fields; it must not make durable ADK skills depend on cache hits, enable hosted runners, user-directory writes, or compatibility defaults. GPT-5.6+ cache option fields and cache-write costs apply only to compatible Responses API hosts after provider/version capability verification; this manifest is not a runner switch.

quality_gates: stable prefix contains durable policy, schemas and reusable examples
dynamic tail contains task-specific user context, logs and diffs
retention policy records whether in_memory, 24h or model_default is used
model support and unsupported in_memory cases are freshness-gated
cached token metrics are observed without becoming correctness criteria
cache misses must not change semantic behavior
Provider-specific cache TTL and breakpoint options must be gated by verified model and API capability, not by an unconditional global policy.
Compare provider-billed cost per accepted milestone, including short and long cache-write charges; cache writes are a subset of input and must never be counted twice.
must_not: treat cache hit rate as correctness evidence
put secrets into stable cache prefix
hardcode volatile model cache support without freshness source
depend on cache persistence for workflow state
send prompt_cache_options or explicit prompt_cache_breakpoint to an unsupported provider/model
interpret cache write token counts as extra input tokens or a successful cache hit as proof of a better outcome

openai_responses_gpt_5_6_plus.requires_verified_capability: Responses API prompt_cache_options on GPT-5.6 or newer
openai_responses_gpt_5_6_plus.prompt_cache_key_role: optional separation of accounting, not needed for cache routing
openai_responses_gpt_5_6_plus.cache_write_pricing: provider-specific charges at 30m or 12h write rate; obtain current prices from provider

legacy_responses.requires_verified_capability: per-model retention support lookup before parameter use

provider_cost_telemetry.source: trusted provider usage and billing receipts, not model estimates
provider_cost_telemetry.comparison_unit: actual provider billed fee per verified milestone
provider_cost_telemetry.supported_provider_without_cache_write_f: record null; retain correct totals and mark cost attribution partial
provider_cost_telemetry.fee_claim_requires: matched real tasks, provider-billed costs and no quality regression
